page.layout: One page, title page, all lines centred: title block, then a woodcut engraving in the middle, then the imprint below it.
page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the title block and the imprint: a bearded figure, nude to the waist with a cloak or drapery at the hips, standing on a rocky shore or sea-monster, holding a harp in his right hand and a lyre-like instrument in his left; a fish or sea creature below. Not transcribed as text. A library stamp in blue ink sits over the lower left of the title block and is excluded. The mark after "A" is a small typographical stroke, transcribed as printed without a stop. The slash through the N of IONAE is an ink or print mark and is not transcribed.
